The code in each guide's tabs is also a program you can run. Each language has a repo with one file per
guide and a shared setup that signs in from `OV_EMAIL`, `OV_PASSWORD` and `OV_SECRET_KEY`. CI builds
or type-checks every example against the released packages on every change and each week.

Running an example does something safe and mostly read-only. The calls that change an account for good
(deleting it, revoking access, rotating keys) are there to read and copy. Try the rest on a test account.

## The repos

| Language | Repo | You need | Run the first program |
|---|---|---|---|
| TypeScript | [openvireo-examples-typescript](https://github.com/openvireo/openvireo-examples-typescript) | Node 22.18+ | `npm run example -- first-program` |
| Rust | [openvireo-examples-rust](https://github.com/openvireo/openvireo-examples-rust) | Rust 1.98+ | `cargo run -- first-program` |
| Python | [openvireo-examples-python](https://github.com/openvireo/openvireo-examples-python) | Python 3.10+ and uv | `uv run examples/first_program.py` |
| Kotlin | [openvireo-examples-kotlin](https://github.com/openvireo/openvireo-examples-kotlin) | JDK 21 | `./gradlew run --args="first-program"` |
| Java | [openvireo-examples-java](https://github.com/openvireo/openvireo-examples-java) | JDK 21 | `./gradlew run --args="first-program"` |
| Swift | [openvireo-examples-swift](https://github.com/openvireo/openvireo-examples-swift) | macOS 13+ and Xcode 16 | `swift run Examples first-program` |
| C++ | [openvireo-examples-cpp](https://github.com/openvireo/openvireo-examples-cpp) | CMake 3.21+, a C++17 compiler, libcurl | `build/examples first-program` |
| ov CLI | [openvireo-examples-cli](https://github.com/openvireo/openvireo-examples-cli) | ov (scripts/install-ov.sh) | `./examples/first-program.sh you@example.com` |

Every repo also has a `check` example that reaches the account server without signing in, to test the
setup.

templates and a GitHub Actions workflow in [`examples/ci/`](https://github.com/openvireo/openvireo-examples-cli/tree/main/examples/ci).
